operators.name: Deductive Reasoning
operators.definition: Derive necessary conclusions from explicit premises.

operators.name: Inductive Reasoning
operators.definition: Generalize cautiously from observed cases and patterns.

operators.name: Abductive Reasoning
operators.definition: Generate and compare the best explanations for observations.

operators.name: Causal Reasoning
operators.definition: Model causal mechanisms, confounders and interventions.

operators.name: Counterfactual Reasoning
operators.definition: Evaluate alternative outcomes under changed conditions.

operators.name: Bayesian Reasoning
operators.definition: Update beliefs from evidence and prior probabilities.

operators.name: Analogical Reasoning
operators.definition: Transfer structural insight across comparable domains.

operators.name: Systems Thinking
operators.definition: Analyse interdependence, feedback and emergent behaviour.

operators.name: Game-Theoretic Reasoning
operators.definition: Analyse strategic interaction and incentive-compatible choices.

operators.name: Adversarial Reasoning
operators.definition: Test claims and systems against capable opposition.

operators.name: Temporal Reasoning
operators.definition: Analyse sequence, duration, timing and path dependence.

operators.name: Probabilistic Forecasting
operators.definition: Estimate uncertain future states and calibrate forecasts.

operators.name: Decision-Theoretic Reasoning
operators.definition: Choose actions under objectives, uncertainty and trade-offs.

operators.name: Optimization
operators.definition: Search for best feasible outcomes under constraints.

operators.name: Constraint-Based Reasoning
operators.definition: Find feasible solutions while enforcing hard constraints.

formulas.name: Weighted score
formulas.purpose: Aggregate normalized indicators with explicit weights.

formulas.name: Confidence interval
formulas.purpose: Represent sampling uncertainty under stated assumptions.

formulas.name: Standard score
formulas.purpose: Normalize observations against a reference distribution.

formulas.name: Min–max normalization
formulas.purpose: Scale values to a common range.

formulas.name: Uncertainty propagation
formulas.purpose: Propagate input uncertainty through a function.

formulas.name: Expected utility
formulas.purpose: Evaluate actions by utility under uncertainty.

formulas.name: Risk-adjusted return
formulas.purpose: Compare return against an explicit risk measure.

formulas.name: Value of information
formulas.purpose: Estimate the decision value of additional evidence.

formulas.name: Reliability series system
formulas.purpose: Estimate joint reliability of serial components.

formulas.name: Bayesian evidence reliability
formulas.purpose: Weight evidence while accounting for dependence.

formulas.name: Time decay
formulas.purpose: Reduce relevance of stale time-sensitive evidence.

algorithms.name: Task and intent classification
algorithms.purpose: Classify request, deliverable, domain, stakes and constraints.

algorithms.name: Adaptive intensity selection
algorithms.purpose: Select L01–L06 from complexity, uncertainty and consequence.

algorithms.name: Context reconstruction
algorithms.purpose: Rebuild relevant context with provenance and conflict checks.

algorithms.name: Task decomposition
algorithms.purpose: Split goals into dependency-aware executable subtasks.

algorithms.name: Knowledge activation
algorithms.purpose: Select relevant domains, topics, formulas and operators.

algorithms.name: Dynamic mode selection
algorithms.purpose: Choose the minimum sufficient reasoning and research modes.

algorithms.name: Source discovery
algorithms.purpose: Discover candidate sources across enabled acquisition channels.

algorithms.name: Source acquisition and provenance
algorithms.purpose: Retrieve, identify and preserve source lineage and retrieval state.

algorithms.name: Entity resolution
algorithms.purpose: Resolve aliases and distinguish entities with similar identifiers.

algorithms.name: Claim extraction
algorithms.purpose: Convert source material into atomic, attributable claims.

algorithms.name: Evidence grading
algorithms.purpose: Classify claim support, limitations and uncertainty.

algorithms.name: Source-dependence analysis
algorithms.purpose: Detect copied, circular or correlated reporting.

algorithms.name: Contradiction detection
algorithms.purpose: Find incompatible claims, definitions, dates and denominators.

algorithms.name: Bayesian evidence updating
algorithms.purpose: Update confidence as evidence is added or challenged.

algorithms.name: Hypothesis generation
algorithms.purpose: Generate competing explanations for observed facts.

algorithms.name: Causal graph construction
algorithms.purpose: Represent causal variables, mechanisms and confounders.

algorithms.name: Counterfactual evaluation
algorithms.purpose: Compare observed outcomes with plausible alternatives.

algorithms.name: Temporal sequence reconstruction
algorithms.purpose: Build event timelines and detect temporal inconsistencies.

algorithms.name: Actor and power-network mapping
algorithms.purpose: Map actors, authority, dependencies and control relations.

algorithms.name: Incentive and game analysis
algorithms.purpose: Model strategic choices, payoffs and equilibrium pressures.

algorithms.name: Adversarial review
algorithms.purpose: Attempt to falsify claims, plans and system assumptions.

algorithms.name: Risk and failure analysis
algorithms.purpose: Identify failure modes, likelihood, impact and detectability.

algorithms.name: Multi-objective optimization
algorithms.purpose: Find feasible trade-offs across competing objectives.

algorithms.name: Decision analysis
algorithms.purpose: Rank options against objectives, constraints and uncertainty.

algorithms.name: Forecast and scenario analysis
algorithms.purpose: Generate conditional scenarios with calibrated uncertainty.

algorithms.name: Memory retrieval and relevance
algorithms.purpose: Retrieve useful memory while separating relevance from reliability.

algorithms.name: Memory conflict resolution
algorithms.purpose: Reconcile conflicting memories with source and version priority.

algorithms.name: Command routing
algorithms.purpose: Route commands to groups, handlers and supported host capabilities.

algorithms.name: Tool and model capability routing
algorithms.purpose: Select only actually available and authorized tools/models.

algorithms.name: Execution orchestration
algorithms.purpose: Execute dependency-ordered tasks with checkpoints and receipts.

algorithms.name: Loop and stagnation detection
algorithms.purpose: Detect repeated actions, no-progress states and stop conditions.

algorithms.name: Independent verification
algorithms.purpose: Validate outputs, calculations, citations, tests and side effects.

algorithms.name: Feedback and adaptive refinement
algorithms.purpose: Use measured feedback to update routing and improve future execution.
